needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The right sidewalk is partly blocked by stacks of goods and pallets
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the right sidewalk to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the right sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the right sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: No proper crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a refuge island to improve safety for crossing pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The existing marked crossing is poorly maintained and hard to see
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing with better markings and signage to ensure visibility and compliance from drivers.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe access for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.
